notes.title: Only one week to go!
notes.notes:
Only one week to go!

🧬The Hive's Origin. Originally a marine research facility, The Hive lost contact with the surface 4 years ago. No one has dared return—until now.

notes.title: Official Release Date: May 29.
notes.notes:
📅 Official Release Date: May 29. 

It’s time to face the fear. We’re thrilled to announce that Submersed 2: The Hive will launch on May 29! Add it to your Wishlist and get ready to descend into the dark.

Are you ready for the horrors of the ocean?

Dive deep into the unknown!

notes.title: New Update Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848421/ad7b218fbce167e102fb4a1b1fdd2e744f7941aa.png[/img]
We have listened to the feedback you have given us these days and we have a new update available with new features and fixes.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added fully support to Xbox controllers on menus
[*] Added support to DualSense
[*] Added a help window to show the keyboard controls
[*] Added localization in Italian, German, French and Portuguese
[*] Added support for 2K and 4K resolutions
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Solved bug with save system
[*] Solved bug that repeats dialogs
[*] Solved bugs on English localization
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: PLAY SUBMERSED 2: THE HIVE DURING STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.notes:
During the Steam Next Fest you can play the new [b]Submersed 2: The Hive[/b] demo for the very first time.

Take on the role of Celeste Brody when suddenly wakes up in an underwater facility that seems abandoned. 

Solve puzzles, find resources and weapons and discover the hidden truth in the underwater facilities where are trapped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848421/7f5e1212ad2eff228bfea850790a2c38f492984e.png[/img]
